# Follow the existing local copy-state member spelling without exporting it globally

This local C++ family uses m_ plus lowerCamelCase members such as m_copyingMultipleMessages and m_allowUndo, while its class is nsLocalMailCopyState. Those names are retained in the constructor and subsequent setup. Keep member spelling consistent when adding state to this class; do not turn a legacy local family into a project-wide rule for all private members.

Scope: Local mail copy-state naming.
